display_cabinet_door.title: Display cabinet door
display_cabinet_door.caption: Find the pair of glass display cabinets on the south wall and use the cabinet at the west end, nearest the wooden console with the cup. Swing open its outer glass door, the one nearest the corner, then close it and let go so it stays shut. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

console_drawer.title: Console drawer
console_drawer.caption: At the bar with two lamps and a vase, use the end drawer nearest the piano, directly below a table lamp. Pull the drawer 25 cm out toward the room, push it fully closed, then let go. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

piano_bench_out.title: Piano bench out
piano_bench_out.caption: At the grand piano, pull the bench 20 cm straight away from the keyboard toward the west wall behind the bench. Keep it upright and let it come to rest there. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

vase_to_floor.title: Vase to floor
vase_to_floor.caption: At the sofa nearest the piano, lift the vase off the side table at the sofa’s piano-side end. Set it upright on the floor immediately north of that table, toward the piano, and release it so it stands on its own. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

nest_bowls.title: Nest bowls
nest_bowls.caption: Lift the small bowl from the coffee table that also holds a vase in front of the east sofa. Carry it to the coffee table near the piano and release it upright inside the larger bowl at the center of that table. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

turn_plant.title: Turn plant
turn_plant.caption: Find the potted plant on the dark round table with the cups. Turn the pot halfway around in its original spot, then release it so it stays upright with the opposite side facing you. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

tuck_chair.title: Tuck chair
tuck_chair.caption: At the dark round table with the potted plant, find the chair on the east side, between the table and the room’s central seating area. Push it 25 cm straight toward the table and leave its seat tucked under the tabletop with the chair upright. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.
